title: NexaCorp Recon Lab
wrong_answer_message: Not the flag yet - keep correlating what the sources tell you.

hints.text: Check the DNS zone for subdomains that aren't linked anywhere on the public site.
A job posting says what software runs on that host. Then look at who at NexaCorp would maintain it.
People often list their handles on other sites in their profile's contact info. Search the paste archive by author.
Once you have a hostname and credentials, use the address bar on the Target Site tab.
